summary.text: Jennifer Gilkerson is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Roy G. Cooper.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Monroe County farmer and small business owner who co-founded Sunset Berry Farm with her husband.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Gilkerson graduated from Greenbrier East High School and earned an associate degree from Dabney S. Lancaster Community College in 1998.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has spent 16 years at Sunset Berry Farm, where she became the first farmer in West Virginia to accept SNAP EBT online.
She said she started the Alderson Strawberry Festival in partnership with the Town of Alderson and Alderson Main Street, and that she is president of the West Virginia Agritourism Association.
Gilkerson was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the survey, she listed family farms and agritourism, education and workforce training, and protection of farmland and water resources as her key messages.
She also said oversight of utility pricing and full funding of public education are among her policy priorities.
